verdict.rationale: Unified search is a fair axis for a work-management platform like Wrike, but the evidence pack never documents a search feature covering tasks, docs, and comments, or its speed or accuracy. Copilot answering questions and natural-language querying via MCP are adjacent AI features, not documented cross-content search, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
